answer: The cheapest real defence: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because jetty only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, sonnet is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any yarrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
